# Psalm 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.

**2** YHWH, in-Your-strength the-king rejoices, and-in-Your-salvation how greatly he-exults!

**3** The-desire of-his-heart You-have-given him, and-the-request of-his-lips You-have-not withheld. Selah.

**4** For You-meet-him [with] blessings of-good; You-set on-his-head a-crown of-fine-gold.

**5** Life he-asked of-You; You-gave-it to-him — length of-days forever and-ever.

**6** Great [is] his-glory in-Your-salvation; splendor and-majesty You-lay upon-him.

**7** For You-set-him [as] blessings forever; You-make-him-glad with-joy in-Your-presence.

**8** For the-king trusts in-YHWH, and-in-the-steadfast-love of-the-Most-High he-shall-not be-moved.

**9** Your-hand finds all your-enemies; your-right-hand finds those-who-hate-you.

**10** You-make-them like-a-fiery furnace at-the-time of-your-appearing. YHWH in-His-anger swallows-them, and-fire devours-them.

**11** Their-fruit from-the-earth You-destroy, and-their-seed from-among the-sons of-man.

**12** For they-stretched-out against-you evil; they-devised a-plot — they-cannot prevail.

**13** For You-make-them [turn their] back; on-your-bowstrings You-aim at-their-faces.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **21:5**: 'Length of days forever and ever' — the royal hyperbole of the Davidic covenant, pointing beyond any single king's lifetime.

— EMET
